title: One deleted lane directory never freezes every task claim
body:
Why: logic audit 2026-11-13: src/task/claims.ts:605 registeredWorktrees calls realpathSync on every registered worktree; a lane directory removed without git worktree prune throws ENOENT, claimLiveness (:461) catches and returns live for every claim, and resolveClaimWorktree (:578) fails every claim with 'not registered'.
Outcome: a missing registered worktree is skipped (and reported once), never poisons other claims.
Proof: regression test with a registered-then-deleted worktree: other claims expire and claim succeeds.
Scope: src/task/, test/task/.
